label: Queijo de manteiga
note: Made from acid-set milk curd, not from finished cheese, then melted with manteiga de garrafa

about.text: A soft, buttery, straw-yellow cheese of north-east Brazil: curd made by acidifying milk is washed, melted and enriched with manteiga de garrafa, then moulded. Brazilian law (IN 30/2001) reserves the name for a purely dairy product.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

facts.v: The name Queijo de manteiga or Queijo do sertão is reserved for a dairy base with no non-dairy fat or protein
